## Rules

Every move is one request. The prompt has the position (FEN, a text board and the moves so far) and every legal move, and asks for {"move": "Nf3", "quip": "..."} . An illegal reply is sent back with the mistake; 3 in a row forfeit the game. Models run on free OpenRouter routes at low effort, up to 16,384 tokens a reply. Arena games stop at 100 half-moves and are judged on material: a lead of 3 or more wins. Ratings are Elo with K = 32.

Your games use the same prompt and the same 3 tries. The thinking shown is what the provider sends, unedited; some send none. A game in progress stays in your browser. A finished game gets its own page and is stored with a daily hash of your IP address, never the address itself. It counts toward the people-vs-models record if nothing was taken back, and never toward the ratings.
